sections.name: Map
points: Replaced every faivel beach with grey sand, also improved the crocodile area a bit, may do some more to this area in the future

Every creature in the game has been replaced with an old mob roughly corresponding to its level and location on the map. Most of these are temporary and will be polished further once the entire map has been retextured. Rare mobs have also been overridden, but their mount / pet skins remain the same.

sections.name: Map
points: Polished the gloomfury area and surrounding paths (east faivel)
Cleaned up the oasis, will be edited more in the future but I am focusing on the older parts of the map first

sections.name: Bug Fixes
points: Fixed an issue where foliage would treat the edge of a chunk as different terrain and cause foliage to be drawn there

Added the highlight own revitalize mod (Settings -> Controls)

entries.title: Update 2.0
entries.description: Rewrote the client, there will no longer be any gameplay "mods", rather I am focusing on continuing the beta retexture, which this client will use by default. I've removed a lot of the procedurally drawn textures from the map, so that is why it will look quite empty (for now).
